laws_and_bills.name: HCR 206 (2026) Large data centers working group
laws_and_bills.what: Concurrent resolution (not a law) requesting the Hawaii State Energy Office to convene a working group on impacts of large data centers on utilities, ratepayers, natural resources and climate goals. Adopted in final form 2026-04-27. Companions HR196, SCR95.

incentives.name: None: no data-center-specific state tax incentive found
incentives.what: Hawaii has no data center tax incentive in NCSL's 'Status of Data Center Tax Incentives, by State (2026)' table (adapted from Husch Blackwell's 50-state survey, last updated 2026-07-27; listed as N/A; table data: https://datawrapper.dwcdn.net/TQYDf/5/dataset.csv). The Hawaii legislature site blocked automated checks, so state statutes were not read directly.
